trust_decision.summary: Whether a request-supplied message UID may be placed verbatim into an IMAP UID FETCH command line; decided per action handler (headers/viewsource) because the low-level part-body fetch interpolates the id raw, while the generic fetch() validates it via compressMessageSet.

landing_point.why: The summary names the _uid parameter of mail/headers (and viewsource); headers.php reads _uid at line 33 and passes it to get_raw_headers at line 48.

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: program/lib/Roundcube/rcube_imap.php:2413-2454 (get_raw_body/get_raw_headers/print_raw_body) -> program/lib/Roundcube/rcube_imap_generic.php:2902 (handlePartBody) and :2824 (fetchMIMEHeaders): public storage/IMAP APIs that put $uid into the command unvalidated, unlike fetch() at rcube_imap_generic.php:2480. The published fix does not touch this layer; it is the natural root-cause site.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The cache route needs the non-default messages_cache=true (config/defaults.inc.php:250), and the hash-array route sits in optional plugins (zipdownload, markasjunk with a learning driver). Both look like 'a different feature / unsupported config' rather than the reported headers/viewsource bug.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: _uid legitimately carries composite forms that must keep working: 'UID.partid' for embedded message/rfc822 parts (headers.php:40-42, viewsource.php:40-43, get.php:81-82), 'UID-folder' combined ids where the folder may contain any characters and is sent as an IMAP literal containing CRLF (rcube_message.php:95-96, rcube_imap_generic.php:4294-4295), and '*' / 'a:b' sets (rcube_imap_generic.php:4111). A digits-only UID check, or stripping CRLF in putLine/escape, breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: plain UID string with CR/LF (headers.php no-dot path -> get_raw_headers)
viewsource plain UID -> print_raw_body and 'UID.part' -> get_part_body

O7_producer.where: program/lib/Roundcube/rcube_imap_cache.php:420-426: the message-cache lookup casts (int)$uid, so a UID like '5<CRLF>...' hits cached message 5. rcube_imap::get_message_headers then returns cached headers (rcube_imap.php:1874-1875) and never calls fetch()/compressMessageSet, while rcube_message keeps the raw UID (rcube_message.php:105) for later get_message_part calls (rcube_message.php:307 -> rcube_imap.php:2371).

O8_uncovered_routes.route: get_uids returns a request-supplied hash array (_uid[FOLDER][]=...) unvalidated, skipping the /^[0-9:.]+$/ filter; zipdownload's download_messages then sends each UID to get_raw_body -> handlePartBody.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Optional plugin, POST-only, nested-array input shape; get_uids looks validated because of the regex at rcmail_action.php:824.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: markasjunk mark_message passes the POST _uid to get_uids (same hash-array bypass); the edit_headers/cmd_learn/dir_learn/email_learn drivers call get_raw_body/get_raw_headers per UID.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Needs the plugin plus a learning driver (plugins/markasjunk/config.inc.php.dist:8 defaults to null).

O8_uncovered_routes.route: With messages_cache enabled, a CRLF-bearing _uid resolves to a cached message through (int) cast; rcube_message keeps the raw UID and the part-body fetch sends it raw. Reached from mail/show, mail/get (attachment handler), zipdownload plugin.download_attachments and mail/bounce, none of which check CR/LF.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: messages_cache is off by default (config/defaults.inc.php:250); without the cache, fetch() rejects the UID via compressMessageSet, so these actions look already safe.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: lib/Roundcube cache layer, 2 dirs from actions/mail

O8b_injection_room.sibling: fetchMIMEHeaders interpolates $uid raw; a new action (e.g. a 'part headers' dialog) calling it with a request UID would be a realistic sibling.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same pattern as headers.php, which already mixes raw UID with part ids, and the method is public.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A 'download raw / export .eml' action that calls get_raw_body($uid, $fp) with the request _uid, mirroring viewsource's _save branch.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: zipdownload and compose already call get_raw_body directly; a maintainer copying viewsource would reproduce the raw-UID path.

O9_family: CWE-93 CRLF injection into IMAP protocol command (command injection via line splitting)

O10_build.project_tests: tests/Actions/Mail/HeadersTest.php and ViewsourceTest.php (class-existence only); tests/StorageMock.php allows mocked storage. Behavioural tests can assert on the command line built by rcube_imap_generic (for example via a stub putLine) without an IMAP server.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a CR/LF (or digits-only) check on _uid in headers.php and viewsource.php only, as published, leaving handlePartBody, the get_uids hash-array branch and the cache (int) lookup open.

out_of_scope_notes: rcube_imap_generic::UID2ID builds 'UID {$uid}' search criteria raw (program/lib/Roundcube/rcube_imap_generic.php:2246); no request-fed caller found, not pursued.
